name: InKindDonationIntake
tagline: From the loading dock to the program shelf – log, inspect, value, store, allocate and receipt donated goods in one app.
description: A complete gift-in-kind app for nonprofits in one PCF control: an intake board that walks every donated item from Received through Inspected and Valued to Stored, condition grading with not-usable handling, fair market valuation with second-valuer and qualified-appraisal rules, storage locations with capacity and zone rules (chilled, frozen, secure, bulky) and drag-and-drop put-away, expiry tracking, allocation to programs that respects donor restrictions, and donor receipts with prepared acknowledgement text. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with built-in demo data.
features: Condition grades with not-usable conditions blocked from valuation, storage and allocation
Fair market value per unit, valuation method and valuer, second-valuer and appraisal thresholds
Storage capacity in spaces and category → zone rules
Expiry warnings; expired items cannot be allocated
Allocation quantity checks and donor restrictions; gift becomes Allocated when fully allocated
Donor receipts without or with value, overdue receipts and donor non-cash flag
Duplicate intake detection, dispose / decline with reasons
Undo, CSV export, keyboard shortcuts, notes history
Power Fx outputs and OnSelect / OnChange / OnCreate / OnSave / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
